_description: ISCA'27 affinity-push on top of v4 Complete: the owner multicasts each read response to the requester plus the requester's 2 learned co-reader partner(s) (top-2 of a 48-entry table of 4-bit saturating counters fed by the previous-reader hint the owner piggybacks on responses; counters halved every 512 hints, partner needs count >= 2; partner list sent in the request header). Partners handle pushes like geo-push neighbors (early delivery to waiting entries, else an invalid L2 way via the M3 fill path; kernel-boundary staleness). Filter: none (shared = only lines the owner's 1024-entry table has seen read by >= 2 GPMs). Extends v4_complete.json (unchanged).
